items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Jimmie said, you know, I never heard this... Strictly Stray Horn. But I'm going to do it on this album... Jimmie really wrote some beautiful things

ctx.x: Okay, I said listen to this tune. Jimmie said, you know, I never heard this. And everybody's talking about "Lush Life." What about "strange feeling", it's a beautiful tune. Strictly Stray Horn. But I'm going to do it on this album, you know.
So these are some of the -- 1951, and I think I met you in 1950, around that time, '51.
